sources.entry: Ombi - Content request system for Plex/Emby, connects to SickRage, CouchPotato, Sonarr, with a growing feature set. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 C#/deb

summary.one_liner: Ombi is a self-hosted media request tool that lets users request movies, music, and TV shows and syncs with Plex, Emby, and related download managers.
summary.what_it_does: Ombi lets users request Movies, Music, and TV Shows, including entire series, individual seasons, or single episodes. It syncs with media servers and shows whether requested content is already on Plex or Emby or already monitored. Admins can manage requests, and specific users can be set to have requests auto-approved and sent to services such as Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, and CouchPotato. User accounts can come from plex.tv, Emby, or local accounts. A landing page shows media server availability and can display custom downtime notifications, and users can receive custom notifications.
use_cases: let family or friends request movies and shows
check whether a title is already on Plex or Emby
notify users about media server downtime
send approved requests to Sonarr or Radarr
how_to_run: Follow the Installation Guide linked in the README
See the reverse proxy config examples linked in the README if exposing it externally
notable: Syncs with Plex and Emby to mark requests as available automatically
Supports plex.tv, Emby, and local user accounts
Feature requests handled on Feature Upvote
caveats: README gives no detailed setup steps; it links to a separate Installation Guide
Listing describes it as having a growing feature set
